description: This is a Kotlin source file defining an Android Fragment for the home screen of a TV app. It constructs the UI programmatically, including a top navigation bar, hero banner, and horizontal rails for 'Continue Watching' and 'TV Channels' sections, with focus management for D-pad navigation.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: Main fragment for the Android TV home screen, containing navigation, hero banner, and content rails with focus management.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates and constructs the view hierarchy for the fragment, setting up the main layout components.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes focus when the view is created.

methods.name: setupTopNavigation
methods.description: Creates the top navigation bar with logo, menu items, and avatar.

methods.name: setupHeroBanner
methods.description: Sets up the main hero banner section.

methods.name: setupContinueWatchingSection
methods.description: Creates the 'Seguí viendo' horizontal content rail with placeholder items.

methods.name: setupTvChannelsSection
methods.description: Creates the 'Canales de TV' horizontal channel list with placeholder channels.

methods.name: dpToPx
methods.description: Converts density-independent pixels (dp) to actual pixel units for layout dimensions.
